exposure: Gestational age at admission for prolapsed membranes (22-25 weeks vs 26-28 weeks)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 194 women with singleton pregnancies admitted with prolapsed membranes at 22-28 weeks' gestation to tertiary hospitals of the Canadian Perinatal Network between 2005 and 2009.
finding: Perinatal mortality among women with prolapsed membranes at very early gestation is high, but significantly lower among those admitted at a relatively later gestational age (26-28 weeks vs 22-25 weeks).
followup_time: Up to the neonatal period (for neonatal outcomes) and throughout hospitalization (for maternal outcomes), but no specific duration after birth is explicitly stated.
